messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ఓ ఇతర కవుల గౌరవం మరియు వెలుగు, నాకు దీర్ఘ అధ్యయనాన్ని మరియు మహా ప్రేమను అందించు ఇవి నన్ను నీ గ్రంథాన్ని అన్వేషించడానికి ప్రేరేపించాయి.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (Telugu → English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | O | vocative particle | ఓ | “O” | OK | | de | preposition “of” (possessive) | — (implied in “కవుల”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | li | definite article “the” (masc. pl.) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | altri | adjective “other” | ఇతర | “other” | OK | | poeti | noun “poets” (genitive) | కవుల | “of poets” | OK | | onore | noun “honor” | గౌరవం | “honor” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | మరియు | “and” | OK | | lume | noun “light” | వెలుగు | “light” | OK | | vagliami | verb “grant/avail me” (imperative with enclitic *‑mi*) | అందించు | “grant” (imperative) | OK | | ’l | contracted article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | lungo | adjective “long” | దీర్ఘ | “long” | OK | | studio | noun “study” (acc.) | అధ్యయనాన్ని | “study (ACC)” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | మరియు | “and” | OK | | ’l | contracted article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | grande | adjective “great” | మహా | “great” | OK | | amore | noun “love” (acc.) | ప్రేమను | “love (ACC)” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which/that” | ఇవి | “these (which)” | OK | | m' | enclitic pronoun “me” (object) | నన్ను | “me” | OK | | ha | auxiliary verb “has” (perfect) | — (tense expressed by “ప్రేరేపించాయి”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | fatto | past participle “made” (causative) | ప్రేరేపించాయి | “caused/motivated” | OK | | cercar | infinitive “to search” | అన్వేషించడానికి | “to search” | OK | | lo | definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | tuo | possessive adjective “your/thy” | నీ | “your” | OK | | volume | noun “volume” (acc.) | గ్రంథాన్ని | “volume (ACC)” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `de`, `li`, both occurrences of `’l`, `ha`, `lo` – Italian articles and auxiliary that have no direct counterpart in Telugu and are therefore omitted. - **No MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR** issues were found; all required meanings are conveyed, and agreement (e.g., plural verb “ప్రేరేపించాయి” with plural subject “ఇవి”) is correct.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 82** - Original: ఓ ఇతర కవుల గౌరవం మరియు వెలుగు, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
